derivation: from a compound of G2087 (ἕτερος) and G2218 (ζυγός);
def: to yoke up differently, i.e. (figuratively) to associate discordantly

occurrences.text: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
